title: The hypercube Ramsey conjecture

result.label: The hypercube Ramsey conjecture
result.statement: Resolves the Burr–Erdős hypercube Ramsey conjecture: the two-color Ramsey number of the n -dimensional cube is (2^n). Thus every red-blue coloring of a complete graph on a universal constant times the cube's number of vertices contains a monochromatic copy of the cube.
